abstract.p: Entity alignment (EA) aims to find the same entities in different knowledge graphs. Existing EA methods assume the supervised aligned pairs without noise. In applications, noisy pairs lead to degradation of EA performance. To this end, a robust EA method based on knowledge distillation is proposed for noisy pairs. Firstly, the dual-teacher model with online distillation is designed, in which, noise discriminator is performed to improve the noise resistance of teacher models. Secondly, a student model is offline distilled from the dual-teacher model without using the noisy supervised pairs, further enhancing the robustness of student model. In addition, the entity structure is combined with entity representation for alignment inference to alleviate the bias of entity representation in noisy environment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
